about.title: About Ranger Painting
text: Ranger Painting is Cedar Park’s & Austin’s trusted painter for exterior, interior, cabinet, brick & stucco - and we never ask for a deposit upfront.
Ranger never does — you pay only once you've inspected the finished work and you're happy.
Look for a written scope, proof of insurance, real reviews, and a quality warranty, all of which Ranger puts on the table before you commit.
